comparison.objective: Unhook and remove an air-fryer basket trivet.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate the basket insert and its retaining hooks while stabilizing the surrounding basket.
comparison.success_condition: Trivet is disengaged and removed without damaging or losing components, then left in the specified stable state.
comparison.reason: Latch/unhook extraction is mechanically different from striking a coaxially held mandrel to fracture four insert tangs and recover the fragments.
